limitations: No package installation or installed phone rootfs modification was performed.

Pacman uses the native guest ARM64 executable and matching glibc loader with explicit disposable root, DB, cache, log and keyring. The verification-only config removes DownloadUser because host NSS differs; signature enforcement remains enabled. Each package also passed host gpgv verification with official public keyrings.
Fedora uses local-file download-only mode with external repositories disabled; this is a dependency plan, not execution of package scripts.
openSUSE dry-run resolved dependencies; its dry-run did not validate installed-file conflict lists for the 375 new packages. Real installation remains a device check.

Native proot-distro extraction-library checks passed for nine base images. The public CLI could not be exercised inside the existing outer proot; do not equate this with a clean-device installation test.
Clean-device installation, launch/rendering, keyboard/permissions and simultaneous new Kali/Manjaro sessions remain unverified.
